name: codealong
description: Pauses your coding tutorial in Chrome while you type, and resumes it when you are done.

codealong.enabled.description: Let CodeAlong pause and resume the tutorial automatically.

codealong.pauseOnTyping.description: Pause the tutorial when you start editing code.

codealong.resumeAfterIdle.description: Resume the tutorial when you have stopped typing for `#codealong.idleDelaySeconds#` seconds.

codealong.idleDelaySeconds.description: Seconds without typing before you are considered done.

codealong.resumeOnSave.description: Treat a manual save (Cmd/Ctrl+S) as "done" and resume about a second later, unless you keep typing. Auto-save is ignored.

codealong.resumeOnTutorialFocus.description: Resume when you switch back to the tutorial tab in Chrome. Handy on a single screen; with several screens it may resume when you only click the browser.

codealong.rewindBeforeResume.description: Rewind a little before an automatic resume, so you hear the end of what the instructor said.

codealong.rewindSeconds.description: How many seconds to rewind before an automatic resume.

codealong.debug.description: Write every CodeAlong event to the "CodeAlong" output channel. Source code is never logged.

codealong.port.description: Local port (127.0.0.1 only) used to talk to the Chrome extension. Must match the port in the Chrome extension.

codealong.allowedChromeExtensionIds.description: Chrome extension IDs allowed to connect. The default is the ID of the CodeAlong extension in this repository.
